waitress.en: The waitress brought our meals and checked the table politely.
waitress.zh: 女服務生送來餐點，並有禮貌地查看餐桌。

waken.en: Birdsong can waken people before their morning alarm rings.
waken.zh: 鳥鳴有時會在人們的晨間鬧鐘響前把人喚醒。

wallet.en: He found his wallet inside the backpack after class.
wallet.zh: 下課後，他在背包裡找到自己的皮夾。

walnut.en: A walnut fell from the tree beside the path.
walnut.zh: 一顆核桃從小徑旁的樹上掉了下來。

wander.en: Visitors can wander through the garden during opening hours.
wander.zh: 遊客可以在開放時間於花園中漫步。

ward.en: The hospital ward was quiet during the afternoon visiting period.
ward.zh: 下午探病時段，醫院病房相當安靜。

wardrobe.en: She stored winter coats in the wardrobe near her desk.
wardrobe.zh: 她把冬季外套收在書桌旁的衣櫃裡。

warehouse.en: The company stores extra supplies in a nearby warehouse.
warehouse.zh: 公司把額外物資存放在附近的倉庫。

warmth.en: The sunlight brought warmth to the room on a cold morning.
warmth.zh: 寒冷的早晨，陽光為房間帶來溫暖。

warn.en: Teachers warn students when severe weather may affect outdoor activities.
warn.zh: 惡劣天氣可能影響戶外活動時，老師會提醒學生。

warrant.en: The evidence did not warrant changing the original conclusion.
warrant.zh: 這些證據不足以支持改變原先的結論。

warranty.en: The laptop comes with a one-year warranty from the manufacturer.
warranty.zh: 這台筆電附有製造商提供的一年保固。

warrior.en: The museum displayed a painting of an ancient warrior.
warrior.zh: 博物館展示了一幅古代戰士的畫作。

wary.en: Researchers remain wary of conclusions based on very small samples.
wary.zh: 研究者對只根據極小樣本得出的結論仍保持謹慎。

wax.en: The candle wax softened slightly in the warm room.
wax.zh: 蠟燭的蠟在溫暖房間裡稍微變軟。

weaken.en: Repeated delays can weaken public confidence in a project.
weaken.zh: 一再延誤可能削弱大眾對專案的信心。

wealthy.en: The novel follows a wealthy family through several generations.
wealthy.zh: 這本小說描寫一個富裕家庭跨越數個世代的故事。

weary.en: The hikers felt weary after walking for several hours.
weary.zh: 健行數小時後，登山者感到疲憊。

weave.en: The artist learned to weave colorful patterns into the fabric.
weave.zh: 藝術家學會把彩色圖案織進布料裡。

web.en: A spider built a web between two garden plants.
web.zh: 蜘蛛在兩株花園植物之間結了一張網。

wed.en: The couple plans to wed in a small family ceremony.
wed.zh: 這對伴侶計畫在小型家庭儀式中結婚。

wedding.en: Their wedding ceremony took place in a quiet garden.
wedding.zh: 他們的婚禮在一座安靜的花園舉行。

weed.en: A single weed grew between the stones near the gate.
weed.zh: 大門附近的石縫中長出了一株雜草。

weekday.en: The library stays open later on each weekday.
weekday.zh: 圖書館每個平日都會開放得比較晚。

weekly.en: Our class holds a weekly discussion about current reading assignments.
weekly.zh: 我們班每週都會討論目前的閱讀作業。

weep.en: The character began to weep after hearing the sad news.
weep.zh: 角色聽到令人難過的消息後開始哭泣。

weigh.en: Scientists weigh each sample before recording the final measurements.
weigh.zh: 科學家在記錄最終測量值前會先秤每個樣本。

weird.en: The machine made a weird noise before shutting down.
weird.zh: 機器在停止運作前發出奇怪的聲音。

welfare.en: The policy debate focused on child welfare and education access.
welfare.zh: 政策辯論聚焦於兒童福祉與教育資源。

whale.en: The documentary followed a whale migrating across the ocean.
whale.zh: 紀錄片跟拍一頭鯨魚橫越海洋遷徙。

wharf.en: Fishing boats returned to the wharf before sunset.
wharf.zh: 漁船在日落前返回碼頭。

whatsoever.en: The test showed no significant difference whatsoever between the groups.
whatsoever.zh: 測試顯示兩組之間完全沒有顯著差異。

wheat.en: Farmers harvested the wheat after several weeks of dry weather.
wheat.zh: 經過數週乾燥天氣後，農民收割了小麥。

wheel.en: One wheel on the cart needed to be replaced.
wheel.zh: 推車上的一個輪子需要更換。

wheelchair.en: The new entrance includes a ramp for wheelchair access.
wheelchair.zh: 新入口設有斜坡，方便輪椅通行。

whenever.en: You can review the notes whenever you need extra practice.
whenever.zh: 需要額外練習時，你隨時都可以複習筆記。

whereabouts.en: The guide asked about the whereabouts of the missing equipment.
whereabouts.zh: 導覽員詢問遺失設備的下落。

wherever.en: She carries a notebook wherever she goes during fieldwork.
wherever.zh: 她進行田野工作時，無論去哪裡都會帶著筆記本。

whine.en: The old fan began to whine after running for hours.
whine.zh: 舊風扇運轉數小時後開始發出尖細聲。

whisper.en: Students had to whisper while the presentation was being recorded.
whisper.zh: 簡報錄影時，學生必須小聲說話。

whistle.en: A whistle signaled the start of the school race.
whistle.zh: 一聲哨音宣告校內賽跑開始。

whoever.en: Whoever finishes first should help organize the remaining materials.
whoever.zh: 誰先完成，就應協助整理剩下的材料。

wholesale.en: The shop buys some supplies at wholesale prices from distributors.
wholesale.zh: 這家店以批發價向經銷商購買部分用品。

wholesome.en: The program promotes wholesome activities such as reading and outdoor games.
wholesome.zh: 這個計畫推廣閱讀與戶外遊戲等健康活動。

whom.en: The teacher asked whom we had chosen as our group representative.
whom.zh: 老師問我們選了誰當小組代表。

whose.en: The student whose project won received a certificate at assembly.
whose.zh: 專題獲獎的那位學生在朝會上收到證書。

wicked.en: The fairy tale features a wicked ruler who abuses power.
wicked.zh: 這則童話描寫一位濫用權力的邪惡統治者。

widen.en: The city plans to widen the sidewalk near the station.
widen.zh: 市府計畫拓寬車站附近的人行道。

widow.en: The novel follows a widow rebuilding her life in a new town.
widow.zh: 這本小說描寫一位寡婦在新城鎮重新展開生活。

widower.en: The story centers on a widower raising two children alone.
widower.zh: 故事以一位獨自扶養兩個孩子的鰥夫為主角。
